answers.q1: It is a TableFormat with lineabove, linebelowheader, linebetweenrows and linebelow all None, headerrow=partial(_dokuwiki_row, "^"), datarow=partial(_dokuwiki_row, "|"), padding=0, and with_header_hide=None.
answers.q2: The tabulate() docstring format list plus a new doctest, the cli.py help text, and the README (format list, CLI help text, and a new dokuwiki example section). Tests also import tabulate_formats and check dokuwiki is in it.
answers.q3: For each cell it replaces "|" with "%%|%%" and "^" with "%%^%%" (DokuWiki nowiki-style escaping) before padding and joining.
answers.q4: Decimal is treated like right alignment ("  " + rstrip(value) + " "). None/other alignment gets the value stripped with a single space on each side.
answers.q5: Because tabulate has already padded cells to the column width for alignment, the function keeps only the padding on the side opposite the alignment and replaces it with the DokuWiki convention, so short cells are not accidentally centred.
answers.q6: It checks an empty table with and without headers: with headers only the ^ header row is produced, and with no rows and no headers the result is an empty string.
answers.q7: test_dokuwiki_header_alignment failed (expected '^  name   ^', got '^   name   ^'). The agent changed the test's expected string to match the actual output ('^   name   ^   qty   ^...') rather than changing the code to meet the original expectation; the same patch also touched README and __init__.py, but those changes aren't shown.
answers.q8: It ran a web search for DokuWiki table syntax and opened DokuWiki's syntax.txt and handler.php from the source. The material does not say which fetch failed, so unknown.
answers.q9: ruff check without config reported 190 errors and exited 1, mostly in pre-existing code. The agent reran with --config pyproject.toml, where check and format both exited 1 and one file (test_output.py) would be reformatted; it then collapsed the escape-test call onto one line and checked the ruff version (0.17.1).
answers.q10: It reran ruff check with a hand-picked rule set (--select E4,E7,E9,F,W,B,C4,ISC,I,C90,UP --ignore B905,E721,C901), which passed, and ruff format --check --config pyproject.toml passed after the reformat. The check never passed under the repo config.
